key_insight: The neural basis method separates fixed neural representations from physics-based projection to solve and learn Navier–Stokes dynamics in shared coefficient coordinates.
engineering_relevance: Learning parameter-to-coefficient maps rather than spatially dependent solution maps offers a scalable route to predictive fluid modeling.
method: Represent flow solutions using fixed neural basis functions.
Project governing equations to determine expansion coefficients.
Learn parameter-to-coefficient maps using a velocity-only residual with an a posteriori velocity-error estimate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis and numerical experiments showing improvements over baselines in accuracy, efficiency, generalization, and scalability, without specifying benchmarks or quantitative gains.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on how well the fixed basis represents the target flows; robustness beyond the evaluated parameter regimes remains to be assessed.
paper_title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
